newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hainan Pearl loses 187 mln yuan in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Hainan Pearl loses 187 mln yuan in 1996.

text.p: (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1995 figures)
Net Profits -186.52 vs 5.17 Earnings per share -0.49 yuan vs 0.0137 yuan
Net assets per share 1.53 yuan vs 2.01 yuan
Company name: Hainan Pearl River Enterprises Holdings Co Ltd.
Note: The results, published in an annual report in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times on Wednesday, were calculated under Chinese accounting standards.
It gave no figures based on international standards.
The firm proposed no dividend for 1996, pending approval of shareholders at a meeting on May 30, the annual report said.
Trading in the company's A and B shares was suspended on Wednesday morning and will resume in the afternoon, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said.
